text.en: No. S 106. -THE SUCCESSION AND REGENCY PROCLAMATION, 1959. (Notification under Section I) In exercise of powers conferred upon him by Section of the Succession and Regency Proclamation, 1959, His Highness the Sultan has appointed the 29th of September, 1959, as the date of the coming into operation of the Success­ ion and Regency Proclamation, 1959. By Command, HAjl IBRAHIM BIN MOHD. JAHFAR Mentri Besar, Brunei.
